source: Audit practice; our view (no regulatory fact)

wa: Hello Valorin, I saw your video on bank confirmations and would like help getting ready for our audit.
linkedin:
Your auditors have written to your bank. That's normal: it's a bank confirmation.

The bank confirms balances directly to the auditor, and evidence from the bank usually carries more weight than copies of your statements.

In our view, three things make it smoother before year-end:
• Sign the bank's consent letter early
• List every account, loan and guarantee
• Reconcile each balance to the books

Is every bank account on your list, including the quiet ones?
